basicimageeditor-desc: Lets users crop, rotate, flip, straighten and adjust uploaded JPG and PNG images in the browser and save the result as a new version of the file
basicimageeditor-nojs: The image editor needs JavaScript. Enable JavaScript in your browser to use it.
basicimageeditor-error-notarget: No file was given. Open the editor from the "Edit image" tab on a file page.
basicimageeditor-error-uploads-disabled: File uploads are disabled on this wiki, so edited images cannot be saved.
basicimageeditor-error-readonly: The wiki is currently in read-only mode. Please try again later.
basicimageeditor-error-nofile: There is no file named "$1" on this wiki.
basicimageeditor-error-remote: This file is stored in a shared repository, not on this wiki, so it cannot be edited here.
basicimageeditor-error-format: Only JPG and PNG images can be edited.
basicimageeditor-error-toolarge: This image is too large to edit in the browser. The limit is $1 {{PLURAL:$1|pixel|pixels}}.
basicimageeditor-error-anon: You need to log in to edit images.
basicimageeditor-error-permission: You do not have permission to upload a new version of this file.
basicimageeditor-error-reupload: You may only upload new versions of files you uploaded yourself, and someone else uploaded the current version of this file.
basicimageeditor-load-error: The image could not be loaded: $1
basicimageeditor-keyboard-help: Drag the handles to crop. With the image area focused, the arrow keys move the crop area and Shift with the arrow keys resizes it.
basicimageeditor-all-uses-warning: Every page that uses this file will show the edited image. Earlier versions stay in the file history.
basicimageeditor-newname-empty: Enter a name for the new file.
basicimageeditor-newname-same: Choose a name different from the original file.
basicimageeditor-newname-exists: A file named "$1" already exists. Choose another name.
basicimageeditor-error-result-toolarge: The edited image is larger than this wiki's upload limit of $1, so it cannot be saved.
basicimageeditor-error-save: The image could not be saved: $1
basicimageeditor-conflict-text: Someone uploaded a newer version of this file after you opened the editor. Saving now would replace that version.
basicimageeditor-conflict-new: Save as a new file instead
basicimageeditor-warning-duplicate: The edited image is identical to: $1
basicimageeditor-warning-duplicate-archi: The edited image is identical to a file that was deleted.
basicimageeditor-warning-was-deleted: A file with this name was deleted before.
basicimageeditor-warning-badfilename: The file name will be changed to "$1".
tag-basicimageeditor-description: Upload made with the in-browser image editor
